name: Alert
description: An alert shows a message about the page or the result of an action: information, success, a warning or an error. It stays in place until the situation changes or people dismiss it.
whenToUse: To explain the state of a page or section, e.g. "Your trial ends in 3 days".
To report the result of an action that people need to notice, e.g. a failed payment.
To show a form-level error summary above the fields.

whenNotToUse.text: For brief confirmations that don’t need to stay on screen.
For an error on a single field.
For decisions people must make before continuing.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: Background and border in the variant’s color; warning uses a dashed border.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: Reinforces the variant; hidden from screen readers.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.description: The message in one short sentence.

values.meaning: Neutral information, e.g. a feature announcement or status.
Something needs attention soon but nothing failed yet.
Something failed or is blocked and needs action.
Tinted background. Default for most messages.
Filled with the variant color. For the one message that must not be missed.
Surface background with a colored border, for busy or tinted areas.

states.name: Dismiss hover/focus
states.meaning: The dismiss button responds to the pointer and keyboard.

behavior.text: Danger and warning alerts use role="alert" and are read out immediately when they appear; primary and success use role="status" and are read politely.
With onDismiss, a dismiss button appears; remove the alert in the handler and move focus somewhere sensible.
Put at most two actions in the actions slot, e.g. "Retry" and "View details".
The alert fills its container; place it at the top of the section it relates to.

content: Lead with what happened, then what to do: "Payment failed. Update your card to keep your plan."
Keep titles to one sentence; put detail in the description.
Avoid blame and jargon; don’t show raw error codes as the main message.

guidelines.do: Match the variant to what happened.
guidelines.dont: Use danger for a neutral announcement to get attention.
guidelines.why: Colors carry meaning; misusing them trains people to ignore real problems.

guidelines.do: Say how to fix the problem.
guidelines.dont: Only state that something went wrong.
guidelines.why: A message without a next step leaves people stuck.

guidelines.do: Show one alert per situation, near what it’s about.
guidelines.dont: Stack several alerts at the top of the page.
guidelines.why: Many alerts compete for attention and get skipped.

keyboard.action: Reaches actions and the dismiss button in order.

aria.when: The icon is decorative; the text carries the meaning.

accessibility.focus: The dismiss button and any actions show the focus ring; the alert itself isn’t focusable.

wcag.how: Every variant has its own icon; warning also has a dashed border.
Title and description pass 4.5:1 in every appearance and theme.
Alerts are announced without moving focus.

notes: Only render alerts that change dynamically with role="alert"; a page full of alerts on load is noisy for screen readers.

examples.title: Information
examples.description: A subtle primary alert with a description.
examples.code:
import { Alert } from '@ds/react';

<Alert title="Real-time data enabled.">Updates every 30 seconds.</Alert>

examples.title: Error with an action
examples.description: Say what failed and offer the fix.
examples.code:
import { Alert, Button } from '@ds/react';

<Alert
  variant="danger"
  title="Payment failed."
  actions={<Button size="small" variant="danger">Update card</Button>}
>
  Your card was declined. Update it to keep your plan.
</Alert>

examples.title: Dismissible
examples.description: Remove the alert when people dismiss it.

related.relation: Use for short confirmations that disappear on their own.
Shows errors for a single field.
Use when people must respond before continuing.

changes: New appearances solid and outline; description, actions slot and dismiss button.
Lucide icons per variant; role="alert"/"status" for screen readers; full width.

components.name: Alert
components.description:
A message about the page or an action: information, success, a warning or an error.
Danger and warning alerts are announced to screen readers immediately; the others politely.

variant.description:
What kind of message it is. `primary` for information, `success` for a completed
action, `warning` for something that needs attention, `danger` for errors and failures.

appearance.description:
Visual weight. `subtle` (default) for most messages, `solid` for the most important one
on the page, `outline` on busy or tinted backgrounds.

icon.description: Replaces the variant's default icon. Pass `null` for no icon.

actions.description: Buttons or links related to the message, e.g. "Retry".

onDismiss.description: Shows a dismiss button that calls this.

dismissLabel.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button. Default "Dismiss".
